facts.text: Intrepid Descent Stage was deployed at Ocean of Storms during Apollo 12 in 1969.
Lower half of Lunar Module Intrepid. Conrad and Bean landed just 163 metres from their target — the unmanned Surveyor 3 probe that had been sitting on the Moon since April 1967.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Validated the precision landing guidance system that allowed subsequent missions to target scientifically valuable terrain features.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Ocean of Storms.
Remains in the Ocean of Storms; its ascent stage was deliberately crashed into the Moon to calibrate the Apollo 12 seismometer.
